resources.string: Perceived effort from 1 to 10. In strength work, 10 means you could not do another rep or add load.
Reps in reserve: how many more you could do with good technique. RIR 2 is roughly RPE 8.
The heaviest load you can lift once with correct technique in an exercise.
Your 1RM calculated from a set of several reps with a formula such as Epley. It is an estimate and loses accuracy above about 10 reps.
Amount of work. The app counts effective sets per muscle and also tonnage (load times reps).
A week with fewer sets or less load to recover and keep your gains before the next block.
A block of several weeks, usually 3 to 6, with one goal. It often ends with a deload.
Gradually raising the demand, with more load, reps or sets, to keep progressing.
Two exercises back to back with no rest between them; you rest after both.
The RPE of the whole session times its minutes. It tracks your internal load week by week.
Every minute on the minute: do the set work at the start of each minute and rest for what is left. E2MOM is the same every 2 minutes.
As many rounds or reps as possible within a fixed time.
8 rounds of 20 seconds of very hard work with 10 seconds of rest: 4 minutes in total.
Finish a fixed amount of work as fast as possible, sometimes with a time cap.
